configured_features_and_placed_features: Converted to native Bedrock feature definitions and feature rules where supported; existing ore features retained and connected to rules.

java_custom_biome_approximations.desert_of_death: minecraft:desert + badlands tags; sand/ore and ruin features
java_custom_biome_approximations.ancient_forest: minecraft:jungle + forest tags; source tree/plant features

dimension_approximations.tensura:hell: minecraft:nether, with Hell gate and three ruin structure rules plus native Nether blocks/features
dimension_approximations.tensura:labyrinth: minecraft:the_end, with the original Java labyrinth block dataset placed as ten connected structures

placement_safety: Large structure rules use biome filters and random-block chance gates to avoid placing a village or cave in every chunk.
